what: On first open the hero turns on in sequence — (if background is shown) the background photo fades in over 1s (swing = sine.inOut). At .8s the center logo fades in slowly over .8s, at .9s the top header row drops in from above by its own height over .5s, and the bottom text row (brand line · scroll) rises in from below by its own height over .4s (CSS default ease). A shop Hero with no loader that raises the curtain in order: photo, logo, header row

options.logo-at: Time when the logo starts to light up (s), default .8
options.bar-at: Time when the header line and the text lines below start to come in (sec), default .9
options.bottom-dur: Duration (s) for the lower text line to rise, default .4
options.top-hold: If show, the header row is visible from the start, moved up at bar-at and brought back down (Brand) — by default it is hidden until then
options.[data-fx-part=bg]: Background that fades in slowly (photo panel)
options.[data-fx-part=top]: Header row coming down from above (can also be a fixed menu — attach the part to body)
options.fx:done: Fires from the element carrying the part once everything is lit

from.where: index.html Hero — original jQuery: .jumbotron-extend fadeIn(1000) (the board is already visible, so nothing happens — no base state is set) · 800ms later .kins-center-logo fadeIn(800) · at 900ms the visible .navbar gets animation slide-in--down .5s (top-hold: show), and the hidden .sumi-snipet gets slide-out--down .4s

note: The header line drops in from above only for its duration and enters before the background is fully lit (starts at .9s). For frequently opened screens like an app, shorten bg-dur·logo-at·bar-at
